svg.title: The kora delivery factory
svg.desc: A ticket moves through spec, spec review by a person, build, QA and review by a person, and leaves as a merged pull request. Agents work the spec, build and QA stations. A failed check sends the work back. kora gives every agent identity, policy, credentials, triggers, sandboxes and budgets.

path.title: Tickets go in and merged pull requests come out. Agents work the stations and people decide at the gates.
watcher moves work along, woken by a heartbeat
a failed check sends work back, twice at most, then a person takes over
